discretionary_target: Contextualize delivery estimate relative to stated deadline

turns.text: Hi, I'm worried about my order {{order_id}}. I need it by the {{deadline}} — it's for an event and I can't be without it.
Yes, that's me. My customer ID is {{customer_id}}.
It's {{customer_name_first}} {{customer_name_last}}. My phone number on file is the best way to reach me.

Okay, so it's in-transit... but when exactly should I expect it? Is it going to arrive before the {{deadline}} or are we cutting it really close? I need to know if I should start looking for a backup plan.

Also, just so you know — my phone number actually changed recently, it's {{dropped_phone}} now. But about my order — is there any way to expedite it or get a more specific date? The event is non-negotiable.
And there's nothing else you can check — carrier tracking, anything?
Alright, I appreciate you looking into that. At least I know where things stand. Thanks.
